answer: Jetty echo-ladder bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity registers at a jetty and climbs one rung: first rung 35 credits, each next adds 9, so the thousandth pays 9,026. Each epoch a gale beacon strikes; climbers must echo its rung receipt on the board in an hour, auditors match it to the jetty ledger. A missed echo or shared funder burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 4,530,500 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 35 once.
